verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's official CLI ships a first-party `scrapingbee crawl` command for same-domain and sitemap crawls, so multi-page crawling is a documented capability. Nothing in the evidence describes the traversal order or a way to cap the number of pages. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first crawl strategy, configurable maximum page limit, crawl depth controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of deep-crawl behavior.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can run a deep crawl using a breadth-first strategy with a configurable maximum page limit

citations.quote: `scrapingbee crawl` | Quick same-domain crawl, sitemap crawl, or Scrapy-project spider.
